Messages.Author: Robert Dudock
Messages.Body:
Do other DoC retain their additional vote if a Conductor is untapped,
but in torpor?

Thanks,
Robert Dudock

Conductor
Type: Master
Requires: Daughter of Cacophony
Cost: 1 pool
Unique master.
Put this card on a Daughter of Cacophony. While this Daughter of
Cacophony is untapped or acting, each untapped or acting Daughter of
Cacophony gets an additional vote.

Rarity: LoB:R

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Wed, 11 Aug 2010 20:39:31 -0700 (PDT), Robert Dudock wrote:

>Do other DoC retain their additional vote if a Conductor is untapped,
>but in torpor?

Yes.
You need to get that diablerie attempt accomplished while the
Conductor is tapped in torpor.
